commits.message: Updated the latest algorithms that I made to solve URI problems. Updated progress of 'Curso Web Moderno com JavaScript 2019' to 51%.
Added new problem solved from URI.
Changed the id 'goTopButtom' to 'go-top' to keep the same pattern to id and classe names

Changed the 'collapsible' button to a div and added a different icon using Font Awesome. Added some small styles changes to it. Rewrote the script to be able to use the same function to expand/collapse the menu when you click on 'collapsible' or any nav list item.
Changed the links from 'Programming problems' from Projects section to my GitHub repo so people can see the actual code and added a link to URI inside the paragraph.
Added a meta 'theme-color' tag to test what happens.
Commented the Design card of Projects section, in the future I'll add it back. Changed the width of 'project' class to 35%.
Created a button that scrolls to top of page and added it's styles
Added 'scroll-behavior: smooth' to html styles.
Changed height and font-size of 'collapsible'.
Forgot to 'git add .'... but now all the files referring to last commit are tracked.

Created a button to show/hide the nav menu on mobile, created a folder for .js files and inside the script to use the button  and created the styles to it inside 'styles.css'. Also added some blank lines inside 'head' to get a better organization of files that are being used.
Changed the paragraph into 'Programming problems' and corrected the h3 tag.
Added links to my GitHub folders into project 'Sites' division.
Added a folder for all favicons. Added lines to all html files to display the correct favicon.
Forgot to comment styles for Support section.

Commented averything related to Support section. Maybe it will return some day if I create a Patreon page. Removed one of the courses because I'm focusing in the other that is similar. Minor changes to 'link-background' styles.
Added the content of credits page and it's styles. Remover 'section-title' of certifications page because it repeats information from the header title.
Added my GitHub profile on Contact section. Created html and css files to credits page.

Created files certifications.html and certifications.css.
Added all the structure and content of certifications.html and corrected the link in index.html to this file (forgot the 'l' at the end of 'html.'
Added the styles to certifications.css to make the page look a little better than with the base styles in styles.css.
Changed h3 tag in Support section to a div tag. It makes more sense. Added the styles to get the same look.
Added styles to work with mobile resolution.

Removed the Support div styles.
Changed last 'link-style-*' to 'link-type-*' (let to many of them pass, I need more attention...).
Added missing styles to footer part of the page.
Added missing styles to Support section and changed the 'div' tag to 'h3'.
Changeg class 'learning' to 'studying' to avoid confusion with id 'learning'. Changed 'percentage' class to 'progress-percentage'. Added missing styles to Learning section.

Added 'card' class to 'learning' and removed 'icon' class from 'learning' img.
Added missing styles to Certifications section.
Created a '.card' style inside 'General styles' and added some styles that are common to 'preoject' and 'certification' classes.
Added missing styles to About section.
Changed 'goTo' and 'more-projects' classes to 'link-background', moved 'more-projects' styles to 'General styles' group and renamed it to 'link-background'.

Added the links and titles of solved problems in Projects section.
Added missing styles to Projecs section.
Added missing styles to hero section
Added the missing styles to header section.

Created the styles.css inside css folder.
Added styles to all tags that are present in more than one section and put them after 'General styles' coment on the file to use as a group.
Changed all 'link-style-*' classes to 'link-type-*'. It was a confusion I made.
Corrected the texts that were outside 'a' tags but should be inside.
Added my contact info to Contact section, a link to Credits page and the copyright.

Added content to Support section. A paragraph with section purpose and a button for a future Patreon page. Changed some href that were blank to avoid strange behavior referring them to their sections.
Added a README file to push my repo to GitHub

Forgot the 's' of 'Certifications' into nav>li>a. Changed to solve no action when clicked.
Changed class 'certification-image' to 'icon' and added the same class to img tags inside Learning section. Some identation changes
'About' text was outside 'a' tag

Added the content of Learning section with four cards. Each one consists of a div with at least one icon to ilustrate, a title, the link to the course or what I'm studying and a progress bar.
Also changed class course-link to link-type-1 to improove CSS styles.
Moved archives from my-webpage to my-website

Created the content of Certifications section with 4 cards each one with it's own title, a little description, an ilustrative icon, certification provider and link to visualize the certification. Created a link to another page where I'll add all my certifications with the same card structure but with a better description, if possible.
Added a paragraph to About section with a little description about me, what I know and what I'm studying
Added the base structure to Projects section. I'll add the missing links later.

Created all sections of my page inside main and footer tags with it's own titles. The sections are:
- Projects
- About
- Certifications
- Learning
- Support
-Contact
Created my-website, images and css folders. Added all images I think I'll use to the images folder. Created index.html and started it's header section with a h2 and nav tags
Update README.md
Moved everithing to the root folder.
Added algorithms to solved problems: 1397, 2794, 2855, 2863, 2896 and 2926.
Added solution to problem 2874 (https://www.urionlinejudge.com.br/judge/en/problems/view/2874).
Added algorithm to solve problem 1079 in C.
Created a repo for some code that may be useful to show or to someone. Inside created a folder for URI solved problems and separetad them inside folders for each language.
Create a simple React TODO list.
Initial commit from Create React App
